ideas.title: The Impact of Minnesota Medicaid Fraud on Medical Services
ideas.description: Investigate how the ongoing Medicaid fraud crisis in Minnesota is affecting medical services for thousands of providers.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and examine the financial impact on healthcare providers.
ideas.insight: This story could uncover the real-world effects of fraud on healthcare services and potentially lead to changes in how these programs are managed.

ideas.title: George Santos and the Kalshi Insider Trading Scandal
ideas.description: Dig deeper into the allegations against George Santos and the implications of insider trading on Kalshi.
ideas.angle: Investigate the extent of Santos' involvement and the potential consequences for financial markets.
questions: What were the specific trades made by Santos?
How does this impact market regulations?
ideas.insight: This story could shed light on the regulatory gaps that allowed such trades to occur and push for stronger oversight.
